title: `sum` of floats: pairwise, Kahan when grouped
verdict: pairwise (full); Kahan (grouped by index); plain across chunks
description: A full aggregation sums pairwise: blocks of 128 in 16 SIMD stripes, combined pairwise, the remainder added in turn. Groups of indices use Kahan summation with a finiteness guard. Streaming merges partial sums plainly.
The sum of no values (or only nulls) is 0 in the Series API.
reference: `AggFn.fsum` (`floatSum`) adds the doubles one by one in list order from +0.0; the writers that need that order exactly use `Dialect.float_sum`. NULL without values.
